paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:2: Rabbi Avdomah of Tzippori, in the name of Rabbi Chuna, in the name of Veyoter Meona. Korban HaEdah and Penei Moshe explain that this is a sage’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading reads ויתור מעונה; the body has ויותר מעונה. The commentators treat this as a sage’s name.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:2:5 text has Evodema of Tzippori in Rabbi Chuna’s name, followed by Vitur and the continuation. The consulted Penei Moshe and Korban HaEdah comments explicitly treat Vitur Me’una as a sage’s name, with differing spelling. The heading and body spellings are retained; the commentators’ interpretation is attributed rather than a new identity binding.
